usage.title: Usage limits
usage.expired: Window has reset (waiting for new data)
usage.enableClaude: Show Claude Code usage (reads the login token from Keychain)
usage.err.no-data: No usage data yet. Run a turn first.
usage.err.no-token: No Claude Code login found in Keychain.
usage.err.unauthorized: The login token was rejected. Run Claude Code to sign in again.
usage.err.network: Could not reach the Anthropic API.
usage.err.http: The Anthropic API returned an error.
usage.err.bad-response: Unexpected response from the Anthropic API.
usage.err.rate-limited: Rate limited by the Anthropic API. Try again in a few minutes.
usage.warn.rate-limited: Rate limited by the Anthropic API; showing the last value.
usage.warn.stale: Could not refresh; showing the last value.
